review_text: The battery range easily exceeds 300 miles on the highway. We had zero range anxiety during our 800-mile road trip.
Super fast charging! Went from 10% to 80% in 18 minutes at a 350kW CCS DC fast charger. Plug and charge worked flawlessly.
Infotainment screen freezes constantly and rebooted twice while driving on highway. Full of software bugs and Apple CarPlay disconnects.
Severe battery degradation after only one year. Lost nearly 22% of maximum battery capacity and dealer refused warranty repair.
Instant torque and thrilling acceleration! 0-60 in 3.3 seconds pushes you right into the seat. One-pedal regen braking is smooth.
Disastrous panel gaps and misaligned trunk lid straight from delivery. Also noticing loud squeaks and rattles in the dashboard.
Whisper quiet cabin at 75 mph with very comfortable heated and ventilated seats. Suspension absorbs bumps gracefully.
Horrendous customer service! Waited 4 weeks for an appointment and the service center held my car for a month waiting for parts.
Incredible value for money when taking into account the $7,500 federal EV tax credit. Saves me $200 a month on fuel.
Left me completely stranded on the shoulder with 'Electrical System Fault' at only 4,000 miles. Total lack of reliability.
Enormous cargo space with the deep trunk and huge front trunk (frunk) for dirty charging cables and groceries.
Winter range is horrific. Dropped by 42% as soon as temperatures hit 20 degrees Fahrenheit. Heat pump barely helps.
Adaptive cruise control and lane centering steer smoothly without ping-ponging. Makes daily commuter traffic stress-free.
Terrifying phantom braking on empty highway stretches while using driver assist. Had two near-miss collisions.
Home Level 2 charging is cheap and reliable. Car is fully charged every morning for less than $4.
